baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative on word 1 governs the name construction in word 2, while words 3-4 identify the named Lord as the one of greatness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clearing branch of the imperative combines with name-as-designation, lordship, and magnitude: the utterance actively removes deficiency or false attribution from the Lord's named identity and renders greatness explicit.

activation_trace.role: Supplies active clearing and exoneration, functioning as the command's corrective operation.
Supplies explicit naming and designation, making divine identity the operation's verbal object or medium.
Supplies ownership and sovereign mastery, identifying whose name is being cleared.
Supplies magnitude and power, giving the clearing act its positive content of magnification.

changed_reading.before: Recite a general formula of praise using the Lord's name.
changed_reading.after: Actively clear the Lord's named identity of every deficient attribution and voice the magnitude proper to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3 can name not only a sovereign but the one who tends, repairs, and brings a dependent thing to completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The formative branch of lordship makes worship and thanks in word 1 relational: the command answers an ongoing process of nurture rather than merely appending an honorific to praise.

activation_trace.role: Supplies gradual tending, repair, and completion, functioning as the reason for the response.
Supplies worship, remembrance, and thanks as the dependent creature's answer to formation.
Supplies the named relation through which nurture is consciously acknowledged.
Supplies inviolable honor, marking the formative Lord as worthy of reverent response.

changed_reading.before: Praise a Lord described by a fixed title of greatness.
changed_reading.after: Answer the One continuously tending you toward completion by naming that relation with worship and inviolable honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion branch of word 1 can interact with the elevated visibility and spreading repute available to word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Running or swimming motion turns the command from a stationary utterance into circulation: the Lord's name becomes a visible and audible orientation carried through an open field of movement.

activation_trace.role: Supplies running or swimming motion, functioning as outward circulation rather than static speech.
Supplies an elevated thing visible at a distance, functioning as an orienting signal.
Supplies good repute spreading outward, functioning as the social path of the name's movement.
Supplies abiding presence and continuity, keeping the circulating proclamation from being momentary.

changed_reading.before: Utter the Lord's name in a bounded devotional moment.
changed_reading.after: Set the Lord's elevated good name in sustained motion through speech and conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial positions, settled arrival, descent, terminal reaching, and the challenged return form a directional system around the focus command. The mobile branch of the imperative now reads as movement that must remain oriented by the named Lord while created things descend, arrive, and pass beyond human retrieval.

activation_trace.role: Supplies free running or swimming, functioning as the focus ayah's trajectory-bearing action.
Supplies a high visible marker, functioning as orientation within the trajectory.
Supplies falling that becomes fixed arrival, giving movement determinate endpoints.
Supplies rising celestial bodies, making the endpoints part of an ordered visible course.
Supplies descent and arrival, transferring the trajectory from the heavens to received discourse.
Supplies reaching a limit, turning motion into a terminal bodily event.
Supplies return or restoration, whose challenge exposes human inability to reverse the course.

structural_cues: 56:75-80 moves from celestial positions to discourse descending from its source.
56:83-87 moves from bodily arrival at a limit to an unanswered challenge to reverse it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies landing, celestial, descent, limit, and return images; I supply the arrow that they form one navigable but partly irreversible trajectory and that the name orients it. A live alternative is that the final command is only a conventional verbal response to these events.

changed_reading.before: Set the Lord's name in general outward motion.
changed_reading.after: Keep motion oriented by the Lord's name across descent, arrival, death's limit, and the point where human power cannot turn the course back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventory for the focus word permits the name to act as a visible identifying mark. The context then joins distinguishing knowledge, fixed writing, protective concealment, restricted touch, cleansing, reality, and certainty. The imperative becomes preparation of both the mark and the reader for truthful access to protected disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a visible identifying mark, functioning as the credential-like face of the name.
Supplies clearing from contamination or false attribution, functioning as preparation for access.
Supplies a distinguishing sign that guides recognition, reinforcing the name as legible marker.
Supplies fixed inscription with binding force, making the disclosure more than transient speech.
Supplies protective concealment, placing the fixed disclosure behind a preserving boundary.
Supplies direct tactile contact, making access concrete rather than merely conceptual.
Supplies removal of impurity, establishing the condition under which contact is fitting.
Supplies stable correspondence with reality, defining what protected access discloses.
Supplies settled knowledge without doubt, completing the movement from mark to recognition.

structural_cues: 56:76-80 orders knowing, writing, concealment, touch, cleansing, and descent as stages of mediated access.
56:95 places stable reality and settled knowledge immediately before the focus command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mark, inscription, protection, contact, cleansing, reality, and certainty; I infer that these stages form an access protocol and that glorification prepares the user of the name. A live alternative is that the purity language concerns the disclosure without assigning the name any credential-like function.

changed_reading.before: Invoke the Lord by a verbal designation.
changed_reading.after: Approach protected reality through the Lord's identifying name while clearing that name and oneself of the falsification that would make contact unreadable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places the same Lord at the source of delivered disclosure, then shows allotted provision being converted into denial, accountability at death, and rest as an outcome. The tending branch of lordship thus spans source, sustenance, completion, and settlement; glorification becomes refusal to sever gifts from their giver.

activation_trace.role: Supplies tending and completion, functioning as the causal arc that joins the contextual stages.
Supplies worship and thanks, functioning as the fitting acknowledgment of the arc.
Supplies delivery from above, establishing disclosure as a received provision.
Repeats the tending Lord at the source of the delivery, linking the focus title to the contextual giver.
Supplies deliberate conversion into a state, identifying the human act that distorts what was received.
Supplies an allotted gift, functioning as the provision wrongly converted into denial.
Supplies accounting and recompense, carrying lordly completion into answerability.
Supplies rest and relief, showing one completed settlement of the tended life.

structural_cues: 56:80 identifies the source of disclosure with the same root used for the Lord in the focus ayah.
56:82-89 sequences received provision, denial, death, accounting, and differentiated settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, the repeated Lord-root, allotted gift, deliberate conversion, accounting, and rest; I infer a single source-to-settlement arc governed by formative lordship. A live alternative is to keep revelation, material provision, and postmortem outcome as separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Thank the Lord for an ongoing but unspecified act of nurture.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledge the Lord who delivers, allots, brings life to its limit, accounts for it, and completes its settlement; do not detach any provision from that source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unseen nearness, failed sight, accountability, inability to restore the departing life, and the final pairing of reality with certainty relocate greatness from sheer scale to an overwhelming actuality that exceeds perception and control while remaining fixed.

activation_trace.role: Supplies awe before what overwhelms estimation, functioning as the focus adjective's experiential force.
Supplies removal of limiting attribution, fitting a reality beyond sight and control.
Supplies nearness rather than distance, preventing greatness from being reduced to remoteness.
Supplies ocular perception at the point of its failure, separating reality from what humans can see.
Supplies accounting and recompense, adding authority to unseen nearness.
Supplies attempted restoration, exposing the boundary of human agency.
Supplies truth verified by performance, turning the failed challenge into an evidentiary test.
Supplies fixed correspondence with reality, grounding greatness in actuality rather than projection.
Supplies stable knowledge without doubt, sealing the evidentiary sequence before the command.

structural_cues: 56:84-87 juxtaposes watching with non-perception and a direct but unanswered demand to restore the departing life.
56:95 immediately names fixed reality and certainty before the consequence marker introducing 56:96.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, failed sight, accounting, failed restoration, performed truth, reality, and certainty; I infer that these redefine greatness as authority exceeding human faculties while remaining present. A live alternative is that the adjective retains only its ordinary honorific force.

changed_reading.before: Call the Lord great in a general sense of magnitude.
changed_reading.after: Clear the present yet unseen Lord of every human measure precisely where sight, reversal, and self-exemption fail before fixed reality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the motion sense of the imperative, an elevated visible sense of the name-root, and the rare sailor-chief branch of lordship. It remains anchored in three focus words and is sharpened by celestial positions and descent, but downstream prose should present it only as a packet-generated navigational analogy, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 1-3 jointly permit an image of moving through a course by a high visible marker under a master of navigation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies swimming or coursing, functioning as the traveler's motion.
Supplies a high object visible from afar, functioning as a navigational marker.
Supplies the chief of sailors, functioning as the one who governs the course.
Supplies fixed points of arrival, giving the imagined course positions.
Supplies celestial risers, making those positions available as orientation.
Supplies a downward course and arrival, extending navigation from stars to disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Glorify by mentioning the Lord's name.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, course by the Lord's elevated name as an orienting marker under the master of the passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant narrow-opening branch supplied under the packet's split mapping for the name-root. It remains anchored to word 2 and gains a material mechanism from touch, delivered disclosure, and the throat conduit, but it should be rendered only as an aperture analogy and never as the ordinary meaning of the word for name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping for word 2 permits a narrow passage image inside the instrumental name construction.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a narrow opening through which something enters, functioning as the name's exploratory interface.
Supplies passage through a medium, making the aperture operational rather than decorative.
Supplies contact across a boundary, establishing an access problem.
Supplies delivery across levels, giving the interface something to transmit.
Supplies arrival at an endpoint, locating passage at the body's terminal threshold.
Supplies the bodily conduit for breath and food, materializing the threshold as a narrow passage.

changed_reading.before: The name is only the content accompanying glorification.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the name is the narrow interface through which received disclosure and mortal breath are oriented at a boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the adjective through its concrete bone branch and joins it to contextual assembly and fitted-joint images. It remains anchored in word 4 and yields a coherent structural model, but downstream prose should label it a material analogy for greatness rather than claim that the adjective literally denotes anatomy here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The concrete hard-bone branch of word 4 permits greatness to be imaged as structural, load-bearing solidity.

activation_trace.role: Supplies hard bone, functioning as the load-bearing frame of the greatness image.
Supplies gathering into a whole, giving the frame material to organize.
Supplies joining one element to another, turning gathered material into articulated structure.
Supplies exact fitting at a joint or receptacle, making the structure cohere with reality.

changed_reading.before: Greatness is chiefly an increase of scale or rank.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, greatness is the load-bearing coherence by which gathered disclosure and fixed reality fit together.

strongest_changes: The command becomes an oriented response to descent, terminal arrival, and the point where human return fails.
The name becomes a protected identifying mark through which disclosure is recognized without falsification.
Lordship expands from title to a source-to-settlement arc of delivery, provision, completion, accounting, and rest.
Greatness shifts from generic scale to present actuality that exceeds sight and control.
summary.what_was_special: A short closing imperative absorbed the pericope's material systems of trajectory, inscription, access, provision, bodily passage, and fixed reality without losing its anchors in the four focus words.
remaining_uncertainties: The instrumental force assigned to the name construction may be weaker than a simple accompanying invocation.
The split-root mark and aperture activations are packet-supported but form-distant and must remain exploratory.
The navigational model may be a useful cross-domain analogy without carrying intended lexical force.
